mapper.sql: cp.id, cp.plan_no, cp.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, cp.plan_name, cp.care_level, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.status, cp.nurse_id, cp.nurse_name, cp.diet_plan, cp.medication_plan, cp.daily_care, cp.rehabilitation_plan, cp.special_notes, cp.create_by, cp.create_time, cp.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM care_plan cp LEFT JOIN elder e ON cp.elder_id = e.id WHERE cp.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM care_plan cp LEFT JOIN elder e ON cp.elder_id = e.id WHERE cp.plan_no = #{planNo}
SELECT FROM care_plan cp LEFT JOIN elder e ON cp.elder_id = e.id ORDER BY cp.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM care_plan cp LEFT JOIN elder e ON cp.elder_id = e.id WHERE cp.elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY cp.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM care_plan cp LEFT JOIN elder e ON cp.elder_id = e.id WHERE cp.status = #{status} ORDER BY cp.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO care_plan (plan_no, elder_id, plan_name, care_level, start_date, end_date, status, nurse_id, nurse_name, diet_plan, medication_plan, daily_care, rehabilitation_plan, special_notes, create_by) VALUES (#{planNo}, #{elderId}, #{planName}, #{careLevel}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{nurseId}, #{nurseName}, #{dietPlan}, #{medicationPlan}, #{dailyCare}, #{rehabilitationPlan}, #{specialNotes}, #{createBy})
